en.text:
General situation: Global corn markets show cautious sentiment amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, with discussions around potential growth in corn production despite war-related uncertainties. What changed vs previous comparable period: This week saw the emergence of a new neutral outlook on corn prospects, contrasting with no notable signals in the prior week. Actionable implications for trading/brokerage: Traders should monitor corn export offers from European ports like Tarragona (CIF at 241 EUR/ton for April shipments) and watch for shifts in sunflower seed oil bids in the Marmara region, which may influence oilseed spreads. The rapeseed market shows stable DAP pricing around 500 EUR/ton for August delivery in Herzlake, indicating steady fertilizer demand. 

Key facts:
 Corn FOB Santos price was 112.7 USD/ton on March 12, 2026; Brazilian soybeans and wheat prices stood at 662.9 USD/ton on March 14, 2026; US spot corn and soybeans were priced at 394.45 USD/ton as of February 4, 2026; Recent broker offers include corn CIF at 241 EUR/ton for April 10-30 from Tarragona and sunflower CPT bids at 301 USD/ton for early March in Marmara; Rapeseed DAP trades fixed at 500 EUR/ton for August 2026 in Herzlake. Overall, the market awaits clearer signals on crop growth potential amid war impacts, with stable fertilizer and oilseed trade flows supporting current price levels.

Порівняно з попереднім тижнем, активність інформаційного потоку зросла, але цінові тренди залишаються без суттєвих змін. Ціни на кукурудзу, пшеницю, сою та соняшникову олію демонструють незначні коливання, зберігаючи стабільний експортний попит. Пропозиції на ринку кукурудзи та ріпаку залишаються конкурентними, що підтримує торгівельну активність.
